description: The transport cannot carry media: no QUIC DATAGRAM support, or the datagram limit is below header + one frame — the Server sends Close(602).
preconditions: Connection established, control stream open (the failure is discovered before/at media setup).
The §7.3 row names Close(602) alone — no paired Error frame.
assertions: retryable=true per §6.2: reconnect with backoff (the condition may be path-dependent).
The interop floor (§7.3): every implementation must accept media payloads up to 1176 B (1200 − 24) — smaller limits than that make the path unsupported; see media/interop-floor-1176.
Unlike 301/601, this row sends a Close FRAME — the §5.2/§7.3 rows decide per case.
